demo.welcome: Welcome to the GalNet showcase: text and variants, media, audio, shaders, masks, character direction, weather and transitions. Pause at dialogue to inspect, then advance.
demo.chapter-text: Text cards · Position, replacement and style
demo.video-lead: First: a skippable video. Then: video as a scene layer alongside dialogue.
demo.audio-lead: Listen to the dry signal, gain, pause/resume, filters and room effects; then compare six sound effects, automation and voice ducking.
demo.mask-lead: Compare layer clipping and letterbox bars, then a slow blink: close, hold, enlarge the opening and fade smoothly. The scene is covered by default; the last example also covers dialogue and cards.
demo.motion-lead: Watch jumps, nods, shake, speed lines and impact; then compare breathing, sway, explicit speaker emphasis and mood.
demo.route-lead: Choose a basic transition. Both routes reunite for wipe, blur, image mask, flash, zoom, pixelation and glitch transitions.
demo.audio-dry: This is the dry signal. Advance to hear one additional effect at a time.
demo.weather-radial-rain: Radial rain: streaks spread outward from the center and align with their velocity. Advance to stop emission; existing streaks fade naturally alongside the following snow.
